title: CoreStaff
description: A lightweight staff moderation toolkit with staff mode, vanish, freeze, inventory inspection and random teleport.
body:
# CoreStaff

CoreStaff is a lightweight staff moderation toolkit for Paper servers.

## Features

- Staff mode with useful moderation items
- Vanish system
- Freeze players
- Inventory inspection
- EnderChest inspection
- Random teleport
- Staff mode inventory protection
- Permission-based commands

## Commands

- `/corestaff`
- `/staff`
- `/vanish`
- `/freeze <player>`
- `/invsee <player>`
- `/ecsee <player>`

## Permissions

- `corestaff.staff`
- `corestaff.vanish`
- `corestaff.freeze`
- `corestaff.invsee`
- `corestaff.ecsee`
- `corestaff.vanish.see`

## Compatibility

- Paper 1.21 - 1.21.8
